fieldworkDateBasis: Primary intro says yesterday and today; primary video title and upload date identify the broadcast as 6 October. Dates resolved relative to the broadcast, not the retrieval date.
missingDataPolicy: Unpublished mode, confidence level, undecided percentage and denominator remain null; do not substitute zero or infer a normalization.
otherPartiesNote: The primary broadcaster reports an aggregate other parties 1%; it does not identify the individual parties. Do not assign this aggregate to any missing individual vote share.
uploadTimeNote: Publisher upload metadata is corroborating publication evidence, not an independently reported exact airing time or fieldwork time.

primaryEvidence.publicationScope: Use the original publisher link and selected stills for audit; do not publish full broadcast segments or incidental app JavaScript.
